summary: Sourced a recovery/context-validity defect in hashicorp/raft: with Config.RestoreCommittedLogs enabled, NewRaft runs restoreFromCommittedLogs (api.go:724-754), which advances lastApplied to the persisted commit index, after which the startup configuration scan (api.go:610-613) begins at max(snapshotIndex, lastApplied)+1. Committed LogConfiguration entries at or below that index are never processed (processLogs only forwards them to the FSM and never updates r.configurations), so a restarted node's membership view reverts to the snapshot's configuration, or to an empty configuration when no snapshot exists, even though its own log holds the committed configuration. A native construction probe of a bootstrapped single node (CommitTrackingLogs, no snapshot, 10 applied entries) showed after_latest_index=0 / servers=0 / hasVote=false with the flag on versus 1/1/true with it off, and the library logged "initial configuration: index=0 servers=[]". Submitted with a two-case harness (RestoreCommittedLogs on versus off, setup event plus result event) as the fixed experiment for a retained receipt; the interpretation is scoped conditional with the defect claim asserted, the snapshot-present variant and the untested pre-runFSM processLogs blocking suspicion left outside the claim.
